leads.title: SB 244 (Kansas, 2026)
leads.documents: Requires state IDs including driver's licenses to reflect sex assigned at birth; requires invalidation and reissue at holder's expense; mandates up to $1,000 financial and criminal penalties for using gender-segregated facility in publicly-owned building not matching sex assigned at birth plus $1,000 bounty-hunter private right to sue
leads.detail: Passed via veto override over Gov. Laura Kelly, took effect immediately Feb 26, 2026; holders received surrender letters warning of penalties for operating without valid credential; ACLU of Kansas filed lawsuit to block

leads.title: SB 180 - Women's Bill of Rights (Kansas, 2023)
leads.documents: Enshrines biological sex definition in state law; prohibits state agencies from recognizing genders beyond male/female sex assigned at birth; directs prohibition from sex-segregated spaces like bathrooms, crisis shelters, prisons where biology/safety/privacy implicated
leads.detail: Passed via veto override April 2023, effective July 1, 2023; AG Kris Kobach stated data and new/updated driver's licenses and birth certificates would only reflect original sex at birth; described as one of strictest bathroom bills but with no enforcement mechanism

leads.title: Kansas Court of Appeals ruling - June 13, 2025
leads.documents: Unanimous reversal of injunction prohibiting gender identity changes to driver's licenses; holds Kobach failed to show irreparable harm from KDOR long-standing policy
leads.detail: Reversed Judge Teresa Watson temporary restraining order citing public safety concern; found error of fact that law enforcement would be hindered if license did not display sex assigned at birth; remanded to Shawnee District Court for reassessment

leads.title: Kansas Supreme Court order - October 2025
leads.documents: Rejection of Kobach request for appeal of Court of Appeals reversal, allowing Department of Revenue to continue allowing changes to gender markers
leads.detail: Follows Kobach suit against two Kelly administration officials over KDOR continuing to serve gender-identity change requests after SB 180

leads.title: SB 63 (2025) / SB 233 (2024) - gender-affirming care for minors ban
leads.documents: Bans gender-affirming care for under age 18
leads.detail: Gov. Kelly vetoed SB 233 April 12, 2024, override failed by two votes; vetoed similar SB 63 Feb 2025, overridden Feb 18, 2025; State District Judge Carl Folsom III granted temporary injunction blocking enforcement May 2026 as part of ACLU-backed lawsuit by parents of two teenagers

leads.title: Kansas transgender sports ban - veto override effective July 1, 2023
leads.documents: Bans transgender athletes from participating in any female sports team
leads.detail: Legislature passed bills April 2021 and April 2022 vetoed by Gov. Kelly; House voted 82-40 Feb 22, 2023, Kelly vetoed March 2023 third time, overridden; Kansas State High School Activities Association stated Feb 2023 schools may decide case-by-case

leads.title: Bostock v. Clayton County, 2020 + Kansas Human Rights Commission guidance Aug 2020
leads.documents: U.S. Supreme Court holds Title VII protects LGBT employees from workplace discrimination on basis of sexual orientation/gender identity; KHRC extends to investigate housing and public accommodations in Kansas
leads.detail: Decided June 15, 2020 consolidated with Altitude Express v. Zarda and R.G. & G.R. Harris Funeral Homes v. EEOC; KHRC covers businesses with 4+ employees vs 15+ under federal ruling

leads.title: Kansas Office of Vital Statistics / Department of Revenue gender-change policy - June 2019
leads.documents: Kansas became 48th state to allow transgender individuals to change gender on birth certificates and driver's licenses/state IDs via affidavit, Application to Amend, plus updated DL/passport or provider certification / court order / medical attestation
leads.detail: Followed Lambda Legal suit filed Oct 2018 arguing denial of updated birth certificate unconstitutional after similar bans struck down in Idaho and Puerto Rico; only Ohio and Tennessee remained

leads.title: Geary County teacher lawsuit - 2022 federal case
leads.documents: Middle school math teacher sued superintendent over requirement to use each student's preferred name; federal judge granted part of preliminary injunction
leads.detail: Injunction allows teacher to out students to parents while case proceeded

leads.title: Lawrence Safe Haven ordinance Aug 2023 / Wichita non-discrimination ordinance Oct 12, 2021 / Gov. Kelly Executive Order Jan 2019
leads.documents: Local and executive-branch rights machinery: Lawrence protects trans city employees/residents from SB 180 effects; Wichita prohibits discrimination in housing, employment, public accommodations on basis of gender identity/sexual orientation; Kelly order protects state employees/contractors
leads.detail: Wichita effective Oct 29, 2021 complaints from Jan 1, 2022; Kelly order follows Sebelius 2007 order rescinded by Brownback Feb 10, 2015; other cities listed: Fairway, Kansas City, Lawrence, Leawood, Lenexa, Manhattan, etc.
